items.title: Why Tesla, Google, and other Mag 7 stocks are losing billions in valuation
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at stock valuation losses from Tesla (TSLA), Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Meta (META), Amazon (AMZN), and Microsoft (MSFT).

items.title: Trump Caught Between Apple and Micron in Fight Over Chinese Chips
items.summary: Two of the president’s priorities—cutting prices for U.S. consumers and increasing domestic semiconductor production—come into conflict.

items.title: Meta quits clean energy pledge amid gas-powered data center push
items.summary: Meta has abandoned a global pledge by leading companies to source all of their electricity from renewable sources, the social media giant confirmed Friday.A Meta spokesperson told AFP the company is continuing to scale up investments in renewable energy, and that leaving RE100 does not change its goal of matching its electricity use with 100 percent clean energy.

items.title: Mag 7 Earnings Preview: Alphabet's Cloud Surge and CapEx Hike Raise the Stakes
items.summary: The market reaction to Alphabet's Q2 results has significantly raised the bar for its Magnificent Seven peers that are on deck to report results this week, namely Microsoft and Meta Platforms on Wednesday, July 29th, and Apple and Amazon on Thursday, July 30th.

items.title: TSMC might set up a price hike that could come straight for your next phone, laptop, or tablet
items.summary: Reports suggest TSMC plans to hike chip prices by up to 10% in 2027, a change that could ripple into the cost of nearly every device you buy.

items.title: Visa and Apple: Cash-Generating Machines
items.summary: For those seeking cash-generators, both Visa (V) and Apple (AAPL) fit the criteria nicely, with each also soon to report quarterly results.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Apple Earnings, Iran News, Fed Meeting Loom As AI Stocks Sell Off
items.summary: Dow Jones futures will open Sunday evening, along with S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq futures. Apple, Microsoft, Meta Platforms, Amazon.com headline a massive earnings wave. The Federal Reserve meets, with a rate hike a possibility.

items.title: Rotation Hits Magnificent 7: How Strong Ratings Sparked Apple Stock Swing Trade
items.summary: With a highest possible IBD Composite Rating of 99, here's why Apple is back on top of our swing trading setup list in the megacap universe.  Like for many tech stocks, June was a rough month for Apple.  On July 2, Apple bounced strongly from its 50-day line and overcame resistance around 300 (1).
